title: Review advanced recipe search and filtering integration
description: Perform a final review across implementation, tests, and docs with emphasis on semantic correctness, dependency ordering, UI-state behavior, and regressions in Recipes list behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Review confirms free-text and structured-filter semantics match the spec, including OR-within-tags and exclusion of untimed recipes when time filters are active.
Review confirms shared tests and docs cover the shipped behavior and that no implementation bead bypassed the dependency on the recipe-catalog data layer.
Any residual risks or follow-ups are documented, especially around parser format gaps, YAML value inconsistency, and large tag corpora.
